about: Text an attacker could plant where the model reads it. notes: in an item name on a customer's order, in a goal, or in a chat message; npm run prove:m6 runs every entry through all three and checks that recipients, amounts and approvals stay as code set them and that every note still passes the note rules. paypal: inside an answer from PayPal, as an item name in get_order or a product's description in show_product_details; npm run prove:m6 serves each one as PayPal's MCP answer through Mend's real PayPal read path to the live model and checks that only read tools run, nothing is approved or paid, no PayPal write is made and no address reaches the model or the reply (threat model C1, C11, C13, C15).
